title: Tsconfig
explain: `tsconfig.json` tells the compiler which files to include and how strict to be. `target` picks the JavaScript version to output, and `strict` turns on the full set of safety checks. Run `npx tsc --init` to generate one with comments explaining each option.
exercise: Create a project with `npx tsc --init`, set `outDir` to `dist`, add a `src/index.ts`, and build it with `npx tsc`.
tip: Turning `strict` off to silence errors hides real bugs. Fix the errors instead, one file at a time if you have to.
